records.subject: Still want to get Harbor Group set up on Wrenfield?

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero reply to the welcome note [email:281753af]; no tickets, so no engagement signal at all. Silent accounts this far into an 8-day remaining window rarely self-activate.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Checking in since your Harbor Group workspace went live last week. If it's helpful, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating one is usually the easiest first step. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything about Wrenfield.

Best,
Chidi
